name.zh-cn: 传输任务定义
name.en: Transfer task definition

name.zh-cn: 已有源数据项
name.en: Existing source data item

name.zh-cn: 目标父节点与资源名称
name.en: Target parent node and resource name

name.zh-cn: 执行边界
name.en: Runtime boundary

name.zh-cn: 装载模式
name.en: Load mode

name.zh-cn: 目标写入策略
name.en: Target apply policy

name.zh-cn: 实际输出到目标字段的映射
name.en: Actual output to target field mapping

name.zh-cn: 一次实际运行
name.en: An actual execution

name.zh-cn: 源身份唯一，并有正式 owner 返回的结构事实；新草稿搜索返回多个候选时由 Runtime 暂停，构建源须匹配用户唯一确认
name.en: Unique source identity with formal owner schema facts; Runtime pauses on multiple source candidates for new drafts and construction must match the unique user choice

name.zh-cn: 真实目标父节点和明确的目标名称
name.en: Observed target parent and explicit target name

name.zh-cn: 有界的一次性执行边界
name.en: Bounded one-time runtime boundary

name.zh-cn: 快照装载模式
name.en: Snapshot load mode

name.zh-cn: 快照写入明确选择 replace（清理后写入）或 append（仅追加），不支持 upsert
name.en: Explicit snapshot policy: replace (clear then write) or append (insert only); upsert is not supported

name.zh-cn: 按真实结构分别确认行粒度与字段保留范围；不展开数组不等于删除数组字段，删减须明确确认；整体保留容器须核实目标可写表示，不将源数组类型当作目标支持证明；查询与映射随完整配置复核
name.en: Confirm row grain and retained fields separately from schema facts; not expanding arrays does not mean dropping them, and omissions need explicit confirmation; verify the target representation of retained containers rather than treating source arrays as target support; review query and mapping with the full configuration

name.zh-cn: Runtime 按正式构建步骤、历史原稿或用户唯一完整配置核验确切参数来源；用户确认完整配置，参数、能力修订或结构事实变化后重新确认
name.en: Runtime binds exact parameters to formal construction, a historical draft or one complete original user configuration; the user reviews the full configuration again after argument, capability or schema changes

name.zh-cn: 完整配置经正式只读预检；unsupported 阻止创建；保留已观察结构对目标类型的反证，采样不能证明可写；unknown 明示限制后知情确认；创建前复检，稳定事实变化后重新确认
name.en: Formal read-only check of complete arguments; unsupported blocks creation; retain observed schema counterexamples without treating samples as write guarantees; unknown requires informed confirmation; recheck before creation and re-review changed stable facts

name.zh-cn: Transfer 只读草稿构建：从已确认资源、行粒度与字段选择推导完整配置及默认类型，整体保留数组默认使用 JSON；仅用户明确转换时提交类型覆盖，返回原参数仍须预检与复核
name.en: Transfer read-only construction derives complete configuration and default types from confirmed resources, row grain and fields; retained arrays default to JSON, type overrides express explicit user conversions, and exact results still require preflight and review

name.zh-cn: Transfer 完整配置的正式只读预检入口；草稿明确要求检查时也使用，不进入创建复核或批准创建；不读取业务行或保证执行成功
name.en: Formal read-only check entry for complete Transfer arguments, also used when a draft check is explicitly requested without creation review or approval; no business rows or execution guarantee

name.zh-cn: 源身份与结构取证入口：搜索定位后读取正式结构事实，不以候选代替事实
name.en: Source evidence entry: discover identity, then read formal schema facts; candidates are not facts

name.zh-cn: 目标父节点取证入口：读取真实目录与祖先，不读取尚未创建的目标
name.en: Target parent evidence entry: read actual children and ancestors, not a nonexistent target

name.zh-cn: 用户对 Runtime 绑定的确切参数与当前事实进行确认，不能由读取 Tool 代替
name.en: User confirmation of Runtime-bound exact arguments and current facts; no read Tool can replace it

name.zh-cn: 用户明确要求运行时，单独申请 Transfer 运行审批并查询真实执行；创建确认不批准运行
name.en: When the user explicitly requests a run, separately request Transfer owner run approval and observe the real execution; creation review does not approve running
